title: Lapsed Auto Insurance or Driver's License Dates and the Lapse Allowance of a Wayfare Document Hold
content:
For a **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreement on a document hold, the lapse allowance days (the calendar days the hold may run from its hold start date before it ends in deactivation for document lapse) change when the auto insurance or the driver's license on the agreement has already lapsed.

## Rule

When the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement falls on or before the day the allowance is worked out, the lapse allowance days change by -20 days (20 days fewer); when the auto insurance expiry date is later than that day but the driver's license expiry date falls on or before it, they change by -10 days (10 days fewer); when both dates are later than that day, they do not change.

Both dates are the expiry dates on the agreement. The insurance date is read first: once it has lapsed, the license date does not alter the result.

## Truth table

| Auto insurance expiry date on the agreement | Driver's license expiry date on the agreement | Change to the lapse allowance days |
|---|---|---|
| on or before the day worked out | on or before the day worked out | -20 |
| on or before the day worked out | later than the day worked out | -20 |
| later than the day worked out | on or before the day worked out | -10 |
| later than the day worked out | later than the day worked out | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, allowance worked out on 2026-08-20)

- Insurance expiry 2026-08-20, license expiry 2027-02-01: the insurance date falls on the day worked out, so the change is -20.
- Insurance expiry 2026-08-21, license expiry 2026-08-20: the insurance date is later, the license date falls on the day, so the change is -10.
- Insurance expiry 2026-08-21, license expiry 2026-08-21: both later, so no change.
